_doc: The levels the picker offers, in order. 'map' is a town file (tools/make_town.py writes San Miguel's). With 'count', the gang is shuffled: that many bandits on the map's guard posts, the count itself the seed (the same count, the same town), the gang's mix kept from the map's own. Without it, the map's hand-placed gang. 'hidden' ones are for the tests. 'budget': the points the stranger spends on the loadout screen (guns and kit; 12 if none: a good gun in each slot and a bandage), by what the town asks of him: Paso Esperanza's open fight the most, Silencio's two gangs (tricks, not firepower) the fewest. 'dynamite': the sticks he has when a test skips the loadout screen. 'hanging': a man on the map's gallows, dropped 'at' seconds in unless the stranger stops it (see scripts/hanging.gd). 'captive': a man tied to a pole (its corner, tiles), stood over by the garrison man placed nearest 'guard', who counts 'count' seconds from the first shot before he shoots him (see scripts/captive.gd). 'stranger': his clothes for the level ({slot: [r, g, b]}, over enemies.json's player palette; painted by the shader, no re-bake). 'brief': what the stranger's told before he rides in: 'job', the level's goal in a plain line (the briefing's and the Esc menu's), 'story', who's paying him this time (the briefing card's opening, before the guns), 'who', the briefing's rows ('kinds': bandit or townsfolk types, a still of each; 'name'; 'line'), and 'cast', who he's up against, under the town's name on the briefing ('%d' for how many; without it, so many bandits, or Silencio's two gangs).

arms._doc: Guns a wave can hand its men instead of their own ('arms' on a wave or one of its groups, by name; [] for their own): loadout options, as in enemies.json.

levels.name: San Miguel
levels.note: A gang holds the town, and a man hangs at noon.

brief.job: Kill the whole gang. They hang an innocent man at noon: save him if you can.
brief.story: A gang holds San Miguel, and at noon they hang the one villager who stood up to them. The mayor has money for a man who can end it.

who.name: The gang
who.line: In the streets, the alleys and the saloon. Some of them dress like townsfolk.

who.name: The hangman
who.line: Waiting at the gallows for noon. While he lives, the man on the rope doesn't.

who.name: The town
who.line: They're paying you. Every one of them you shoot, they'll remember.

levels.name: San Miguel (waves)
levels.note: For testing: 20 bandits, then more down the roads every minute and a half.

levels.name: Cruz Verde
levels.note: A fort asleep, a prisoner at the well. They keep coming.

brief.job: Free the prisoner at the well, then hold the fort against every band. He will be executed if you are too slow.
brief.story: Your partner got on the wrong side of the revolution, and they're holding him at Cruz Verde. The federales want that fort back, and might pay a man who comes out of it alive.

who.name: The garrison
who.line: They won a battle yesterday and drank to it all night. A few stand watch; the rest are sleeping it off with the girls.

who.name: Your partner
who.line: Tied at the well, with a man standing over him who has orders to shoot.

who.name: El General
who.line: Asleep in his house. When he comes out, he goes for your partner himself.

who.name: The revolution
who.line: Camped all round the fort. They'll come down every road to take it back.

levels.name: Paso Esperanza
levels.note: Hold off the army while the revolution loads the train.

brief.job: Protect the carriers until the train is unloaded, then leave on the last wagon. The federales want the guns back.
brief.story: The federales never paid for Cruz Verde. The revolution pays in gold: they've stopped a train full of the army's rifles, and need a gun to cover the unloading.

who.name: The carriers
who.line: Unarmed and slow under a load. Lose them all and the job's lost.

who.name: The comandante
who.line: Your employer. He keeps them working and won't take cover for anyone.

who.name: The federales
who.line: They still owe you for Cruz Verde. Today they've come for their guns.

line.text: Pintamos de rojo sol y cielo

levels.name: Silencio
levels.note: Two gangs snowed in under a truce, and the outlaws' gold.

brief.job: Steal the outlaws' gold and carry it down to your horse, or kill both gangs. Turn them against each other.
brief.story: Gold meant to buy the revolution its guns fell into the wrong hands, and the thieves are holed up in the mountains. You ride up just as the snow shuts the pass behind you.

who.name: The bounty hunters
who.line: At the east end of town, waiting out the winter for the outlaws' heads.

who.name: The outlaws
who.line: At the west end, sitting on the gold. The truce with the hunters won't take much to break.

who.name: The townsfolk
who.line: Snowed in like everyone else, and no part of it.

levels.name: A Good Man Never Dies
levels.note: His own funeral. Everyone he crossed came to see it.

brief.job: Break out of your coffin before they bury you, then kill everyone who came to watch.
brief.story: Everyone you ever rode for, or against, has come to see you buried. It looks like your luck finally ran out.

who.name: The mourners
who.line: San Miguel's gang, the revolution, the army and the north. Kill one and his friends send for more.

who.name: The padre
who.line: He reads your life over the coffin. Every sin he names is another nail in the lid.

who.name: The townsfolk
who.line: They came for the funeral, not the fight, and they'll run at the first shot.

levels.name: Test yard
levels.note: A bare yard: no streets, townsfolk, reserve, boot hill or holdouts.
